title: Floral Tulle Cape Slit Maternity Photoshoot Gown
seo_title: Floral Tulle Cape Slit Maternity Gown | Dress Like Mommy
seo_desc: Maternity photoshoot gown with a sheer tulle cape trimmed in 3D flowers over a slim dress with a high slit. 2 colors, US 2 to 26W, made to order.
lead: Made for your maternity photos: a slim, satin-look gown with a wrapped sweetheart bodice and a high front slit, finished with a flowing sheer tulle cape that drifts from the shoulders and is trimmed with soft 3D tulle flowers all the way to a sweeping train.
bullets: each gown is sewn after you order and is ready to ship in about 7 days, so please allow about 19-23 days for delivery. Order early for a planned photoshoot.
wrapped sweetheart bodice on off-the-shoulder straps, slim skirt with a high front slit, a sheer tulle cape-sleeve layer with 3D tulle flowers, a long train and a lace-up back.
US 2 to US 16 and plus sizes US 18W to US 26W. Compare your bust, waist and hips with the chart below.
Hand wash cold or dry clean; hang to dry. Steam on low to remove creases.
chart_footnote: Body measurements in cm. Choose by your bust and hips today, and size up if you want extra room over the bump. Hollow to Floor is measured from the base of the neck to the floor, barefoot.
closing: Perfect for maternity photoshoots, gender reveals and baby showers.
garment_lock: a fitted maternity gown with a satin-look wrapped sweetheart bodice on off-the-shoulder straps, a smooth slim skirt with a high front slit, and a very long sheer tulle cape-sleeve layer falling from the shoulders to the floor and trimmed with large 3D tulle flowers down both sides and around a sweeping train; lace-up back
